commit.message:
ref(event-details): Move all event error logic to EventErrors and use react-query (#43771)

- Moves proguard error logic from `EventEntries` to `EventErrors`
- Proguard mappings request now uses `useQuery`
- Moves an analytics call `issue_error_banner.viewed` to `EventErrors`
- Moves related tests to `EventErrors` (and adds some extra coverage)
